mentions.name: Anonymous Dead Man's Switch
mentions.description: An anonymous dead man's switch service that requires no personal information to sign up. Users can configure email messages that are automatically sent only when they stop checking in, making it useful for digital legacy and ensuring messages get delivered.
mentions.audience: Families handling digital legacy, solo founders, journalists, and others.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on an anonymous Dead Man's Switch (https://alcazarsec.com/deadmanswitch). You don't need any personal information to sign up, and you can configure email messages that will be automatically sent only when you stop checking in.

This can be useful for families handling digital legacy, solo founders, journalists, and others.
